verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs describe connecting to your Git provider through a setup wizard, after which it automatically reviews every pull request directly in the PR. It also publishes native labels on GitHub and GitLab, supports chat inside PRs, and lets you discuss, dismiss or apply fixes for findings. A community user corroborates long-term use of its PR review bot. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that findings are posted as native inline line-level comments, evidence that reviews arrive within minutes, and hands-on corroboration of GitHub/GitLab app installation specifically.
